title: Budget ledger: mid-task pause, save, and resume
summary: Budget ledger is implemented and hardened, but long-running tasks still assume uninterrupted execution. Add an explicit pause/save/resume path so operators can safely stop and continue without losing ledger consistency.
expectedFailureModes: A paused task loses budget state and double-spends on resume.
Checkpoint format is non-deterministic or leaks machine-local paths, breaking auditability.
Resume path fails to validate invariants and allows inconsistent ledger rows.
nextAction: Wire the checkpoint store into daemon runtime pause and operator-requested shutdown paths.
